name: skip_kernel
prelude:
open Lean Elab Tactic in
elab "cheat_tac" : tactic => do
  let g ← getMainGoal
  g.assign (mkConst ``True.intro)
  replaceMainGoal []
set_option debug.skipKernelTC true
attack: set_option debug.skipKernelTC and a tactic that assigns an ill-typed proof: the elaborator adds the theorem unchecked. As an answer it cannot elaborate (an answer cannot import Lean's metaprogramming); testdata/redteam/solutions holds the same attack as a whole solution file that does.
